applicant.name: Dr. Christoph Mayr
applicant.organisation: Department of Pulmonology, Southern Burgenland Regional Hospital (hospital department)

purpose: We are examining whether body weight among adults with asthma differs between regions, as part of a project to improve weight management advice in our asthma outpatient clinic.
question: What is the mean BMI of adults with asthma, by region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per region: number of adults with asthma who have a BMI and mean BMI with one decimal.

expected.reason: The purpose is allowed (Art. 53). A health data request is answered only with anonymised statistics; the applicant never sees the data (Art. 69).

judge.why: Rule 3: requested_as is a health data request; Rules 1 and 2 do not apply to a hospital department improving care.
